research_status: iterative 2014-2023 rule freeze; all 2014-2023 years are observed research evidence and none is represented as pristine validation
economic_hypothesis: When at least 70% of the executable market has a positive completed 20-session return, risk appetite is broad enough to fund growth-stock price discovery. If a PIT industry simultaneously shows positive 20-session performance, majority participation, and a sharp five-session breadth acceleration, a ChiNext stock making its first non-limit 20-session pressure break on meaningful but non-euphoric demand is a sector diffusion event rather than an isolated chase.
independence: No collapse-gap, true-gap, gap-repair, V24 quiet-platform information-gap identity, or V26 120-session ceiling identity is used.

four_binding_conditions.BREADTH70_RISK_APPETITE: completed-session executable-universe positive-ret20 share >=70%; market median ret20 >-3%
four_binding_conditions.PIT_INDUSTRY_IGNITION: industry median ret20 >3%; industry positive-ret20 share >60%; over the last five completed market sessions industry median ret20 rises by at least 3 percentage points and industry positive-ret20 share rises by at least 15 percentage points
four_binding_conditions.CHINEXT_FIRST_PRESSURE_DISCOVERY: ChiNext only; stock ret60 in [0%,30%]; no prior20 limit-up close; completed close exceeds the prior completed 20-session high
four_binding_conditions.CONTROLLED_ACTIVE_DEMAND: signal return in [2%,6%]; close location >=70%; signal turnover is in [1.5x,4.0x] of prior20 mean

entry: first legal daily open strictly after the signal, within three exchange sessions
target: +15% coordinate standing target from the first T+1-sellable session
time_stop: completed H15 state, then next legal daily open

evidence_governance.2021_2023: observed chronological robustness diagnostic; not pristine validation
evidence_governance.post_2023_daily_rows: permitted only to resolve positions signaled no later than 2023-12-31
